obsbot.isConnected.description: Checks whether Cuebot can reach your OBSBOT camera (through OBSBOT Center) right now.
obsbot.isConnected.returns: true while OBSBOT Center answers, otherwise false.

obsbot.connect.description: Starts connecting to OBSBOT Center. Cuebot keeps trying in the background until it works.

obsbot.getState.description: Asks your OBSBOT camera for its current settings, like zoom and where it is pointing.
obsbot.getState.returns: Values named obsbot.deviceIndex, obsbot.deviceName, obsbot.awake, obsbot.zoom, obsbot.fov, obsbot.pitch, obsbot.yaw, obsbot.aiLocked, obsbot.autoFraming, obsbot.deviceCount and obsbot.preset1.exists / .name (and 2, 3).

obsbot.send.description: Sends any raw OSC message to OBSBOT Center. For advanced users who know OBSBOT's OSC addresses.

parameters.args: Optional. A list of values to send with it, like [50].

obsbot.setZoom.description: Zooms your OBSBOT camera in or out.

parameters.zoom: How far to zoom, 0 (all the way out) to 100 (all the way in).
parameters.device: Optional. Which camera in OBSBOT Center, 1 to 4. Leave it out for the selected one.

obsbot.setGimbal.description: Points your OBSBOT camera in a direction. Numbers past the camera's limit are cut down to the limit.

parameters.pan: Optional. Left/right in degrees, -129 to 129 (a Tail 2 reached directly: -159 to 159). Default 0 (straight ahead).
parameters.pitch: Optional. Up/down in degrees, -59 to 59 (a Tail 2 reached directly: -62 to 62). Default 0.
parameters.speed: Optional. How fast it turns, 0 to 90. Default 50.
parameters.device: Optional. Which camera in OBSBOT Center, 1 to 4. Leave it out for the selected one.

obsbot.triggerPreset.description: Moves your OBSBOT camera to one of its saved positions (presets).

parameters.device: Optional. Which camera in OBSBOT Center, 1 to 4. Leave it out for the selected one.
